label: MHT-CET 2024 13th May Shift 2 Q147
reason: copy: MHT-CET 2024 13 May Shift 2 Q147: options √55, √155, √138, √170; key (b)
solution:
Let \(\vec{r} = x\hat{i} + y\hat{j} + z\hat{k}\). Then \(\vec{r} \times \vec{a} = (4y - 3z)\hat{i} + (2z - 4x)\hat{j} + (3x - 2y)\hat{k} = \hat{i} - 2\hat{j} + \hat{k}\).

So \(z = 2x - 1\) and \(y = \frac{3x - 1}{2}\). Then \(\vec{r} \cdot \vec{c} = x + y - z = \frac{x + 1}{2} = 3\), so \(x = 5\), \(y = 7\), \(z = 9\).

\(|\vec{r}| = \sqrt{25 + 49 + 81} = \sqrt{155}\).
